summary: Read all 32 available units and checked all 48 date/hint items and 13 people. Failed review: invented early-life bounds, marriage dates borrowed from accession/enfeoffment, posthumous honor treated as both death and living activity, unsupported hint endpoints, missing relative death chronology, and unresolved Western-year conversions for late lunar months. Primary parallel passages confirm an earlier Zhang marriage and a conflicting Qin-title witness. This is a complete negative audit, not an approved chapter or a completed repair.
